senses.gloss: ch. m. (Ithp. of סן, v. סנן a. שנן) the clear or cold wind, hence north-wind, North.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 23a:17">Keth. 23ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 12b:3">Kidd. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>עדים בצד אסתן</he> the witnesses are in the North (Babylon; v. Tosaf.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 37:22">Targ. Job XXXVII, 22</cite> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="A02580"><he>אִסְתַּנְיָא</he></cite>); h. text <he>זהב</he>).—
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:14">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא אסתנא וכ׳</he> (Ms. <cite ref="A02549"><he>אי׳</he></cite>) the northwind comes and clears the sky.
<cite ref="Eruvin 65a">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> a Talmudic decision must be as clear <he>כיומא דא׳</he> as a northwind day; <cite ref="Megillah 28b">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite>.
